```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use App\Models\Url;
use App\Models\User;

Route::apiResources([
    'urls' => Url::class,
    'users' => User::class,
]);
```

This code snippet defines the routes for the `Url` and `User` models using Laravel's `apiResource` method, which automatically generates all the necessary API resources. The `routes/api.php` file in your Laravel application will now handle all requests related to these models, providing a clean and organized RESTful API structure.
